reviews.review_text:
YowTran
London, United Kingdom98 contributions
0
Excellent Food
Aug 2019 • Family
8 of us came here for the dim sum lunch buffet and the food was really good. The cost was approximately 400,000(after tax) which also included 1 free drink. There were some dishes where you could help yourself to and the rest were ordered from a menu. The menu wasn't vast but it was enough and the quality was high. I would recommend all of the steamed dim sum and the crispy roast pork was the best I have ever tasted. The skin was really really crispy! The other really good thing was that the wait for our dishes after ordering was short. Dim sum at the Golden Dragon is definitely worth a visit.
